role_summary: The Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) role focuses on developing and maintaining automation frameworks primarily using Python. A successful candidate will have a strong background in API testing and CI/CD processes, along with the ability to mentor junior team members. The role requires a detail-oriented individual who is passionate about quality assurance and continuous improvement.
